title: A Double Feature With Sandow Birk in Person (Dante's Inferno/In Smog and Thunder)
synopsis: In collaboration with Sandow Birk: An Illustrated History of the Present, Three Decades of Pictures, Stories, and Other Histories. August 29 - November 7 at the Catharine Clark Gallery. 7:30pm:  DANTE'S INFERNO (2007)9:15pm:  Q&A with Sandow Birk 9:30pm:  IN SMOG AND THUNDER (2003)About the FilmsDANTE'S INFERNO (2007)A darkly comedic travelogue of the underworld - set against an all-too-familiar urban backdrop of used car lots, gated communities, strip malls, and the U.S. Capitol. And populated with a contemporary cast of reprobates, including famous - and infamous - politicians, presidents, popes, pimps. And the Prince of Darkness himself. IN SMOG AND THUNDER (2003)California was teetering on the edge of doom. Animosity between Los Angeles and San Francisco had grown out of control. War was looming in the hearts of men and women from Petaluma to Pacoima. Then, in early May, General Juan Gomez de los Angeles led his Southern troops in an offensive against the Bay Area. Once the Battle of San Francisco began there was no turning back. In Smog and Thunder is a mockumentary about a California civil war set in a vaguely recent past.Friday, November 6

title: Nirvanna the Band the Show Season One
synopsis:
Playing as part of Nirvanna the Band the Show the Fest: a weekend long celebration of Nirvanna the Band the Show featuring both seasons, and the movie + Back to the Future on 35mm!
Individual and double feature tickets for purchase at buttons below Season One, Ep. 1 - 4 ~ 7 PM "The Banner"In an effort to raise awareness of the band, Matt and Jay drop a huge banner across from The Rivoli. Unfortunately, it turns out to be more revealing than they'd planned."The Booking"Matt and Jay form a secret undercover plan to sneak in to the local Toronto newspaper listings so they can try to book their own gig."The Bean"Matt and Jay are left wondering if Christmas miracles exist when they try to get their own float into the Santa Claus parade and face issues at every turn."The Blindside"Matt prepares for the release of the next Star Wars movie by watching the original trilogy. However, after sitting for too long in front of the TV, Matt goes blind on the day of the premiere.This film can be used with loyalty cards or our 2026 annual CinemaSFBay passes
Season One, Ep. 5 - 8 ~ 8:55 PM "The Big Time"Matt convinces Jay that to book a gig at the Rivoli, they need to make a film. Matt sneaks it into Sundance, becoming a pseudo-celebrity and spiralling out of control."The Boy"Matt and Jay befriend a sick kid to use his final wish to ask for Nirvanna the Band to play the Rivoli. They wind up showing him the time of his life, but will time run out?"The Buffet"Jay writes Matt a letter saying that he intends to leave the band; over a feast at an all-you-can-eat Chinese buffet, Jay tries to work up the courage to read Matt the letter."The Bank"Matt and Jay find themselves unwitting and unwilling participants in a hostage situation. Instead of a crisis, Matt sees an opportunity to get the band to the Rivoli.This film can be used with loyalty cards or our 2026 annual CinemaSFBay passes

synopsis:
